title: A tooth that wears
hook: Grit can gradually wear a chewing surface.

knows: Animals have structures and behaviors suited to particular conditions.
doesNotKnow: The taller crown extends farther above the marked root boundary in this toy comparison. High-crowned teeth can provide more material to wear down in some grazing mammals; actual wear and tooth growth differ among species.

misconception: A familiar animal behavior or structure must work in a different way.
objective: In this simplified wear comparison, which tooth has more crown material above the root to wear down?
